_meanings:
.²1 A lock of hair left on the crown of the head at tonsure.
.²2 Locks or tufts of hair left on the sides of the head; (these are three
 or five in the case of the Kṣatriyas); {#kuvalayadalaSyAmasnigDaH SiKaRqakamaRqanaH#} <ls>U. 4. 19</ls>.
.²3 A crest, tuft, plume.
.²4 A peacockʼs tail.
.²5 The fleshy part of the body below the buttocks.
.²6 (With Śaivas) One who attains a particular degree of emancipation;
 also {#SiKaRqika#}.
